# ResumeDoctor (resumedoctor.in)
# Machine-readable site map for AI crawlers and assistants.
# Last updated: 2026-05-20

> ResumeDoctor is an India-first resume and CV builder. Users create ATS-friendly resumes, maintain them in the cloud, share a live resume link, and export PDF/DOCX on Pro via SuperProfile checkout.

## Product facts

- Domain: https://www.resumedoctor.in
- Category: Web resume builder (SaaS)
- Geography: India-first (Naukri, LinkedIn India, campus, referrals)
- Free entry: OTP Try at /try (no card)
- Paid: Pro via SuperProfile (same email as account required)
- Differentiator: Shareable resume link that stays current after edits
